resources.string: Cable type and size from tables N°4.17 to N°4.20 of RIC N°04, with outer diameter and area.
From 1 to 5, including the earth conductor if it is in the bundle.
Usable inner diameter (not nominal). Allowed fill is 50 % with 1 conductor and 33 % with 2 or more.
Usable width by height. Conductors must not exceed 40 %.
How many fit in a conduit
How many fit in a tray

Sizes conduits and trays per RIC N°04: nominal conduit for 1 to 5 conductors (tables N°4.17–4.20), maximum number in a conduit (table N°4.21) or in a tray (40 %). Tables apply to runs up to 20 m with no more than two bends totalling 180°.
